title: Side Panel Toggle Hotkeys
description: Ctrl+B should always toggle the last active left panel; Ctrl+Shift+B should always toggle the last active right panel.
summary: Added `useSidePanelChromeHotkeys` in `@semio-tech/ui-react` (Ctrl/Cmd+B and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+B). `ProductShell` registers them when parents supply toggle handlers. `PlatformView` toggles the last active left/right panel kind (desktop visibility or mobile sheet), and syncs mobile panel opens into `activeDesktopLeftPanelKind` / `activeDesktopRightPanelKind`. `PlaygroundView` toggles left/right side panel visibility.
